value.text:
Kish International Campus is a campus of the University of Tehran on Kish Island in Iran. Established in 2007, it is described as public in the captured university profile. Its institutional identity is that of a campus within the University of Tehran, rather than a separately established university. English is the campus's official language, and the captured article states that its courses are offered in English.

The campus offers bachelor's, master's and doctoral programmes across several academic fields. Its departments include engineering, fine arts, law, management, English, physical education and sports sciences, economics, and science and biotechnology. The undergraduate offerings listed in the article encompass architecture, industrial design, painting, urbanism, several engineering fields, financial management, accounting, industrial management and law. Postgraduate study extends across management, engineering, design, literature and legal subjects, while the doctoral list includes languages and literature, law, sports sciences, accounting and management.

The article's undated profile reports approximately 2,500 students. This figure is an approximate observation without a stated reference year. The captured profile also gives the English motto as “Rest not a moment from learning.”
